goals: Verify that the alert registration endpoint accepts requests and processes them to initiate verification email delivery.
activities: Select a random server name from a predefined list.
Construct a JSON request payload containing a test email and the selected server name.
Send an HTTP POST request to the `/api/alerts/register` endpoint with the JSON payload, setting content type and a 65-second timeout.
Verify that the HTTP response status is either 200 (OK) or 500 (Internal Server Error).
Verify that the HTTP response status is 200 (indicating successful email sending).
Pause the test execution for 2 seconds.
